ch.01.name: Install it in Chrome
ch.01.desc: Search the Chrome Web Store for “Inspiration Collector”, add it to Chrome, then pin it to the toolbar.
ch.02.name: Open the panel, pick a folder
ch.02.desc: Click the toolbar icon to open the side panel. The first time, pick a folder and allow it once in Chrome.
ch.03.name: Save a whole page
ch.03.desc: “Save page” in the side panel saves the whole article as one item. Saving the same page twice still leaves one copy.
ch.04.name: Save a passage
ch.04.desc: Select a few sentences, right-click the highlight and choose “Save selection to Collector”. One passage, one item.
ch.05.name: Save images
ch.05.desc: Right-click to save one image at full size; use “Images” to pick several. Small icons are skipped.
ch.06.name: Save one AI reply
ch.06.desc: “Save this”, at the end of each reply in ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity, saves just that reply.
ch.07.name: Save a whole AI chat
ch.07.desc: “Save page” on a chat saves the whole conversation, marked with who said what. Perplexity keeps its sources too.
ch.08.name: Save files ChatGPT made
ch.08.desc: “Files” saves the original xlsx, py and md files ChatGPT made into assets/. It is greyed out on other sites.
ch.09.name: Sort with topics
ch.09.desc: “New topic” makes a folder and a sentence on what it is for, written to MATERIAL.md. You can change it any time.
ch.10.name: Move between topics
ch.10.desc: Breadcrumbs show where you are, and every level is clickable. “Switch topic” changes topic; “Change folder” changes where everything is saved.
ch.11.name: Tidy the list
ch.11.desc: “List” or “Grid”, ALL / TXT / IMG / FILE, search and “On this page”. Delete takes two clicks.
ch.12.name: What is in the folder
ch.12.desc: One .md per item, original files in assets/. Every item records its source at the top; MATERIAL.md explains the folder to your AI.
ch.13.name: Hand it to your AI
ch.13.desc: After five items, “hand it to your AI” appears: paste the path, copy the prompt and paste it into Claude Code. It reads everything and returns a sourced outline (from a real run).
ch.14.name: When the folder is locked
ch.14.desc: Left idle, the folder locks: click “Unlock folder”. If the side panel cannot unlock it, the lock icon at the top opens a separate page.
ch.15.name: Page tools off, clearing data
ch.15.desc: Turning “Page tools” off removes the buttons on web pages; the side panel still saves. The trash icon shows what will be deleted first.
ch.16.name: Help and support
ch.16.desc: “How it works”, “Get help” (checks everything on the spot), “Privacy” and “About me”.

news.title: {Latest news}
news.1.title: 1.0.5: “Save this” is back after the ChatGPT redesign
news.1.body: Just update from the Chrome Web Store. If a site changes its layout again, the collector will first try to find the conversation on its own.
news.2.title: ChatGPT redesign: “Save this” and “Save page” don’t work for now
news.2.body: Other websites, Claude and Perplexity are not affected. The fix ships with 1.0.5.
news.3.title: Tutorial videos are up: 16 chapters, 3 languages
news.3.body: From installing to handing it to your AI. Click a chapter to start there.
changelog.title: {Release notes}
changelog.105.1: Fixed: after ChatGPT's redesign the "Save this" button disappeared and "Save page" could not find the messages
changelog.105.2: New: if a site changes its layout again, the collector now tries to find the conversation on its own (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity), so it keeps working until the next update
changelog.105.3: Fixed: if the folder you collect into is deleted or moved, the collector goes back to the "Choose folder…" screen and says why, instead of looking as if nothing happened
changelog.104.1: Fixed: thumbnails overlapping in grid view when there are many of them
changelog.104.2: Fixed: saving several images or files now ends with "Saved N images / files" instead of just "Saved"
changelog.104.3: Fixed: list titles no longer carry link or image syntax (Perplexity replies that open with a citation, ChatGPT image replies)
changelog.104.4: Fixed: text cut off or squeezed in the English and Japanese interface (the top label, sources in the list, dialog buttons)
changelog.104.5: Japanese interface now uses a Japanese font and breaks lines between phrases
changelog.104.6: Removed the button that popped up after selecting text: select, right-click and choose "Save selection to Collector" — selecting text no longer adds a button to the page
